en: And I think I got everything I need and more from this interview. It was a pretty great harvest, actually!
Hehe. Well, I'll be going now. Thanks for everything!
Hello. Thank you for coming today.
My name is Ioka. I'm the director of "Love to See You Smile."
Hello, I'm Haruka Sawamura of Dyna Chair. It's very nice to meet you!
You as well. So, let me tell you about the show you're going to be on today. "Love to See You Smile" is one of Osaka's longest-running talk shows.
Our host, Nomu-san, and the guest of the day talk to each other one-on-one, discussing a variety of funny and interesting topics.
You know who Nomu-san is, yes? He's the heart and soul of the show, not to mention the most popular TV host in Osaka right now.
You'll be on for five segments, so, including this one, we'll be doing five recording sessions.
Nomu-san will guide the conversation, so just relax and go with the flow.
And when the audience shouts encouragement, you can smile or wave.
Okay, I understand.
Great. Lastly, when the talk segments are over the audience gets to vote.
Vote?
Yes, that's the tough part of the show. Every audience member who thinks the guest was interesting gives the guest one vote of support.
We count those as "smiles." A perfect score is 100.
We're hoping you can get at least 70 smiles. And I suppose it wouldn't be saying much for your popularity if you didn't, right?
Right... I'll do my best.
All right, we're about ready to get started. Knock 'em dead, Haruka-chan!
Hello and welcome to "Love to See You Smile"! How is everybody doing today?
So-so!
I see! Well, that's all right, then! How are you all sleeping these days?
And what's that toy children flick up and down?
Yo-yo!
Hahaha. Thank you, thank you! You're a lovely audience! We're gonna get along just great!
Okay! Our guest today is on our show for her first time ever. She's a rising singer fresh on the scene, please welcome, Haruka Sawamura-chan!
Hello, everyone! I'm Haruka Sawamura! It's nice to meet all of you!
Haruka-chan! You're so cute!
Haruka-chaaan!
Yes, she really is adorable, isn't she? A true idol!
Huh? What's with her?
What's this? Giving the audience the cold shoulder, are you? Can't you even wave to your fans?
Oh, I'm so sorry! I was caught off guard, I didn't⑬
Yes, yes. We understand. You got nervous and froze, right?
Well, let's get to know you a little better, shall we?
They tell me you're from Okinawa. Okinawa has a very warm climate, right? Doesn't that make Osaka too chilly for you?
It is a little cooler here than in Okinawa, but I like Osaka weather just fine.
I'm glad to hear that. You must notice a lot of differences between Osaka and Okinawa. What's your general impression of Osaka so far?
Well, come on, say something!
Yes, all right. Try to get into the rhythm of things, won't you? At this rate, I'm not sure if you're gonna make it!
The comedians here are very funny. Even ordinary people kid around a lot. They all have this way of making their conversations hilarious!
Yeah, that's what we Osakans like to hear! We pride ourselves on being the home of comedy, after all!
And now that you're on Osakan TV, you must have the chance to meet lots of comedians. Tell us, would you ever consider going out with any of them?
Oh, um... Well, under the right circumstances, maybe I might.
Ha! She doesn't mean it, folks! I can tell by the look in her eyes!
Osakan food is so delicious! I especially love takoyaki and fried pork skewers, but I have to be careful not to eat too much!
Yeah, that's what we Osakans like to hear! We pride ourselves on being a town of culinary extravagance, after all!
Oh, but you're so nice and slim. I'd feel bad if Osakan food made you gain weight!
I'll try to resist the temptation to overeat.
Well, I wish you the best of luck with that. Because looking around at our audience, I can see there are plenty of people here who can't manage it!
Uh-oh. Now everybody's mad at me!
It does seem like it, yes.
People seem a little scary here in Osaka.
Hmm. There are quite a few rough and rowdy types, I suppose. And maybe the Osaka dialect does makes people sound scarier than they would without one.
Yes, I think the dialect makes people sound a little angry, even when they're just speaking normally.
Haruka-chan. Saying something like that on an Osakan TV show certainly isn't going to win you any popularity points.
Okay, Haruka-chan. I hear you've only been in the entertainment industry for about six months, is that right? Did a scout find you?
Yes, that's right. I was just doing some shopping when someone came up to me.
Hehe, with those looks, it's no surprise!
But weren't you suspicious of this person coming up to you out of the blue?
Yes, actually I was.
Well, now that you're an entertainer, what do you think? What's been the biggest thrill so far?
Well, say something!
You have to try and keep the conversation going, Haruka-chan. You're on the clock, you know.
It's still strange to see myself on TV shows I've watched for years. It's a weird feeling.
Yes, yes. I'm sure it must be. But it must make you feel good too, right? I bet you review the shows afterwards to see how you did.
I do. Most of it still makes me wince, though. I have a lot to learn.
I know just what you mean. Even I still watch myself on TV, then reflect on how I did when I take my bath at night.
Speaking of which, when you take a bath, what part of your body do you wash first?
Oops! I guess that wasn't a very smooth transition, was it?
By way of apology, I could tell you which part of my body I wash first. Would you like to know?
Oh, um. Not especially, no.
Having so many wonderful fans support me has been the greatest thrill of all. Nothing like this has ever happened to me before. It's really moving.
I'm glad to hear you still appreciate your fans. Some idols forget all about them when they start making it big, and it's just too bad.
Oh, I'll never forget my fans.
Good answer, Haruka-chan! You're making a very good impression on everybody today.
Meeting you, Nomu-san! I'm a big fan.
Haha, there you go, Haruka-chan! That's the perfect answer!
You'll do well in this business! And I just became your diehard fan for life!
And look at that beautiful smile, folks! We love to see you smile!
Now, let's see. You've been living alone since you came to Osaka, haven't you?
That's right. My agency provided an apartment for me.
Have you ever lived on your own before? Isn't it lonely being there all by yourself?
Don't you have an answer!?
Earth to Haruka-chan... Come on, I feel so alone if you don't answer!
No. I've never done it before, so everything just feels new and exciting.
Well, that sounds nice. But don't you get homesick every now and then?
Well, I've been all right so far. I'm usually so busy, I don't have much time to think about it.
Ah, I know what's keeping you busy. The Princess League, right?
I never miss a show, myself! But I guess I have to say that, right? It's one of this station's shows, after all!
Yes. It does get a little lonely sometimes, being all by myself.
Yeah, I bet it does. You don't even have anybody to say "I'm home!" to when you get back.
You know, if you ever get too lonely, I could come and keep you company.
Eww!
Aw, what's wrong with that? I'm just trying to be nice! She said she was lonely!
Isn't that right, Haruka-chan?
Oh, well, I'm not sure about you coming over...
So that's a no, huh?
Yes, it gets really lonely. It makes me want to go back to Okinawa.
Hey, cheer up a little there, Haruka-chan! You're bringing the whole audience down!
Hang in there, Haruka-chan!
Now look what you did. You made everything all awkward!
Well, time flies when you're having fun, as they say. And it looks like we're just about out of it.
Now comes the part our guests always say makes them nervous. It's time for the smile vote!
Each one of our audience members has a button in front of them. If they think Haruka-chan has been interesting, they'll press their button and give her a smile!
Haruka-chan, if you get 70 smiles or more, I'll give you an exclusive Nomu-san cell phone strap.
Before the voting begins, why don't you go ahead and say something to the audience?
Gah, say something!
Okay! Audience, if you thought Haruka-chan was interesting, press your button now!
Thank you for your wonderful support, everyone! I hope you vote for me!
Isn't she absolutely adorable? I hope you all vote for her, too!
I was really nervous, but I had a lot of fun. I hope you'll vote for me!
Isn't she cute, everybody? I hope you all vote for her, too!
I'm usually more interesting than this! But I still hope you can vote for me!
Hmm, I dunno. That kind of sounds like something a sore loser would say...
Wow! Fantastic job, Haruka-chan! Looks like we found another one of your many talents!
And best of all, you win the Nomu-san strap!
Well, until we meet again! What's that we always say? Love to see you...
Smile!
Thank you, everybody!
Good job, Haruka-chan! That means you get the Nomu-san strap!
Ahh. The result wasn't as high as we hoped, but I'm sure you'll do better next time!
Thank you, Haruka-chan! That went well!
Thank you! I'm glad you think so.
Yeah, you're pretty good at this talk show thing! Keep it up for next time, and we'll have some great shows!
Thank you, Haruka-chan. So, it looked like you had some trouble out there.
Yes. I'm very sorry.
Well, talk shows are tough, and you're still learning. Just try to shake it off, and do better next time!
Hello, Haruka-chan. Thank you for coming again today.
This is your second time on the show, isn't it? Good luck to you today.
Thank you. I'll do my best.
This time, we want you to talk about your hobbies and special talents. You know, things that are more personal to you.
Just follow Nomu-san's lead and you'll do fine.
Oh, by the way. Nomu-san has been doing commercials for a hangover medicine lately. He'll probably bring it up here and there, so just play along, okay?
Great. And since this is your second appearance on the show, we're hoping you get at least 75 smiles this time around.
Very nice! You said it all in unison! Okay, how are you all sleeping these days?
And what's the acronym for "you only live once"?
YOLO!
Hahaha. Thank you for always playing along with me, folks! I really appreciate it!
Let's get started then, shall we? Today's guest will be joining us for the second time now. It's the lovely singing sensation, Haruka Sawamura-chan!
Hello, everyone! I'm Haruka Sawamura! It's nice to see all of you!
Haruka-chan, you're so cute!
What a great smile you have, Haruka-chan! Who wouldn't fall in love with you?
Oh, I'm so sorry! I was caught off guard, and I couldn't⑬
Okay! Today, let's touch on your personal life a little bit, shall we?
I'm sure you have quite a busy schedule these days. Do you get any time off?
Not really. Even when I'm not working, I still have singing and dance lessons every day.
That sounds pretty rough. If you could have a day off, how would you wanna spend it?
Wow, you can't even imagine a day off, huh? I think you might be a workaholic.
Dyna Chair had better give you some time off on the double!
I'd like to go shopping. I love looking at clothes and accessories.
I could take you shopping, you know. I'm pretty good at picking out ladies' lingerie.
Um, I don't need any lingerie, thank you.
Oh ho. Right now, the audience is looking at me with disgust. I might be jumped in a back alley by Haruka-chan fans after the show!
I'd like to take a little eating tour. I'd love to just walk around Osaka and try out all the different foods.
Yeah! After all, Osaka is the town of culinary extravagance. Hey, I could show you around to some great places.
And when you get a little older, we can go out drinking too.
I'd like that.
You would? Really? Hmm. I think your agency might have something to say about that!
I'd like to try sleeping the whole day away. I wouldn't get out of bed once!
Hey, that sounds a bit lazy now. You have to get out and get some exercise. That's what I do on my days off.
Sure! I go drinking in cabaret clubs, or I go play mahjong or something.
Oh? But I don't know if you could really call that exercise.
Haha! Come on, I set up that punch line perfectly! You're supposed to say, "Ya call that exercise!?"
